notes.title: Fat[EX] Courier Simulator - Devlog #73 "Further UI Changes!"
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Couriers! [/h1]

[h2]So many changes that we've been showcasing lately... and we're not stopping![/h2]

We've taken care of our courier's image, we've provided him with a new truck and we've even been diligent enough to prepare new boxes and packages for our customers. Everything for the sake of great deliveries and doing awesome job. However - that's not enough! We strive to make even more great adjustments and improvements and this time we're thinking... about you!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/693342e1939ca48ae56811dac147aa6412b12b4b.png[/img]

UI changes, afterall, are addressed to you! We want you to feel as comfortable when playing the game and enjoy the adventures of your courier to the fullest. A clean, nice looking UI is the way to go and we strongly believe that similar to package being important for the customer and truck for our driver - the new UI elements will be working in favour of your enjoyment! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/40a244b38cd47cfb5ef219098feeb17cbc33fdff.png[/img]

Minimap, speedometer and even watch - all of them will be valuable tools letting you know more and perform your job on the highest level. As the dark blue is the colour that is inherently linked and combined with our company we decided to use it for the new UI elements and we believe that they look quite nice! What do you think? Be sure to let us know about your thoughts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33238425/5959f858911b245f4c50304e0587f48e7e1929a0.png[/img]

[i]Let us know about your opinion in the comments![/i]

Best regards,
Fat[EX] Courier Simulator Team
